title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description: TCS is hiring Graduate Engineer Trainees for the 2025 batch. This role involves working on cutting-edge technology projects, receiving training from industry experts, and contributing to live client projects. An excellent opportunity for fresh graduates to kickstart their career in the IT industry.

title: Software Development Engineer
description: Join Amazon's core development team to design, develop, and deploy large-scale distributed systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. Experience with cloud services is a plus.

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: This is a 12-week paid internship for students. You will work on a real Google project, contributing to the development of user-facing features. This role requires a strong understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Data Analyst - Fresher
description: Accenture is looking for fresh diploma and degree holders to join as Data Analysts. You will be responsible for collecting, processing, and performing statistical analyses of data. Strong analytical skills and proficiency in SQL are required.

title: Cloud Support Associate
description: As a Cloud Support Associate, you will be the first point of contact for AWS customers. This role requires a deep understanding of cloud computing concepts, networking, and operating systems. Excellent communication skills are a must.

title: System Engineer
description: Infosys is hiring System Engineers to manage and maintain IT infrastructure. This is a great role for diploma holders and graduates with a passion for system administration and troubleshooting.

title: Web Development Intern
description: Wipro's remote internship program offers hands-on experience in web development. Interns will work with a team of experienced developers on real-world projects using PHP and MySQL.

title: Internship in Web Development
description: Zenoids is offering an unpaid Web Development Internship with hands-on training, real project experience, mentorship from senior developers, and exposure to frontend and backend technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, and Shopify. Interns will work on live projects, receive guidance from experienced developers, and build a strong portfolio. Certification is provided only upon full attendance and successful completion.

title: Graphic Designer
description: FirstCry.com is hiring creative Graphic Designers for full-time roles in Pune. Responsibilities include designing digital marketing creatives such as social media posts, following design trends, meeting deadlines, and collaborating with the design team. Candidates must have strong design skills and expertise in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, with basic After Effects knowledge. BFA, GD Art, Diploma, or equivalent qualifications are preferred.

title: Administrative Officer
description: Raisoni Group of Institutions is hiring an Administrative Officer for G H Raisoni Public School in Jalgaon. The role includes handling day-to-day administrative tasks, managing general office duties, supporting the school staff, maintaining smooth operations, and ensuring organized workflows. Strong communication, administrative assistance, and organizational skills are essential. Fluency in regional language(s) is desirable. Interested candidates can apply by sending their CV to samiksha.landge@raisoni.net.

title: Inside Sales (Intern)
location: Warrier Electronics, 180/1, Ravet, Ganesh Nagar, Pune, Maharashtra 412101
description: This role is for one of Zepcruit's clients. Zepcruit is an AI-powered hiring platform that automates sourcing, screening, AI interviews, and shortlisting. Responsibilities include cold calling HR/TA teams, booking demos, following up with prospects, running outbound outreach (LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp), cold calling job seekers for mock interviews, maintaining CRM entries, and supporting the sales team. Requirements include strong verbal communication, comfort with cold calling, interest in HRTech/SaaS sales, and being organized and proactive. Perks include a competitive stipend, founder mentorship, PPO opportunity, and real B2B sales exposure.

title: Unpaid Internship
description: NotWorking is offering a nationwide unpaid internship from 1 January 2026 to 1 February 2026. This remote internship is open to freshers, job seekers, students, and career-break professionals looking for real experience, visibility, and community. Interns will gain hands-on exposure to startup culture, flexible work with no minimum hours, networking opportunities, and a Certificate of Completion. Available roles include content writing, social media handling, graphic design, community management, research, marketing support, testing/feedback, and outreach. Apply now to work with a meaningful platform built to support individuals navigating unemployment and career breaks.
